GENERATED by tools/plant_prairie_1904_street_trees.py from the parkway bands of data/street_grid/1904.json -- do not hand-edit; re-run the tool. Local ENU metres of data/datum.json. Drawn by renderers/web/js/street-trees.js with trees.js's own tree builder (the 1835 American elm). docs/RESEARCH/prairie_1904_street_trees.md is the reading; docs/LIBERTIES.md L-prairie-parkway-elms-2473 the inventions.

species.note: The one file of tall, high-crowned elms in the parkway of the 1887-91 west-walk photograph at 18th Street (printed 1891-93, reissued on a postcard postmarked 1908), and the 'single row of closely spaced elms' of the 1905 Views of Chicago plate. Elm is the reading of the crown and bark in those prints and the street tree Chicago planted; it is inferred, not named by any record read.

placement.pictured: data/street_trees/pictured_1904.json: stretches whose trees are read off solved pictures and stand in place of the rule's (T-1934, L-pullman-18th-street-trees-1934).
placement.note: Every position off a pictured stretch is reconstructed: one file per face at about 30 ft, nearer the curb than the walk, kept 10.5 m from each face's end (about 6 m past the cross street's line) and 3.5 m of an alley mouth, with about one young replacement tree in twelve and one gap in twenty-five, as the photographs show such a file. Faces beyond the Prairie Avenue blocks the pictures show are planted the same way and are reconstructed outright.
